Name: 3D Infinity
Overview: 3D Infinity is an on-rails space shooter that features real 3D graphics. The player controls a ship that can fire a normal shot as well as lock-on missiles, and must shoot enemies and avoid obstacles while flying along a pre-programmed path. The ship can move freely around the screen, but will always move forward, and can also perform a barrel roll in either direction to avoid obstacles. When the ship is hit, it loses shield energy, and if the energy is depleted, the ship will explode and the game is over. The game offers three difficulty levels, and two different 3D graphics methods in addition to the standard display mode.
